assessmentQuestions.questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Adhoga Raktapitta is yapya because virechana can not be administered here.
Statement II: Urdhavga Raktapitta is Sadhya, because it is treated with virechana.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.label: A
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.label: B
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

options.label: C
options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect

options.label: D
options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct

assessmentQuestions.explanation: In Charaka Samhita Chikitsasthana 4 (Raktapitta Chikitsa), Pratymarga Harana principle applies: Urdhwaga Raktapitta is easily curable (Sadhya) because purgation (Virechana) is its prime counter-path treatment; Adhoga is Yapya because Vamana has limited feasibility and milder drugs are required.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not contraindicated in spring season according to Ashtanga Hridaya?

options.text: Amla Rasa Substances

options.text: Lavana Rasa Substances

assessmentQuestions.questionText: Which of the following is not caused by suppression of Adhovata Vega according to Ashtanga Hridaya?

assessmentQuestions.questionText: Which of the following disease is not manifest in the newborn, due to bearing down efforts made (Pravahana) in the absence of labour pains?

options.label: B
options.text: Minminatva

options.text: Badhira

options.label: D

assessmentQuestions.explanation: In Charaka Samhita Sharirasthana 8/38, untimely straining (Apravahana kale pravahana) causes birth defects including deafness (Badhira), muteness (Mooka), and nasal twang/speech impediment (Minmina). assessmentQuestions.questionText: Which of the following antihypertensive drug is not safe in pregnancy?

options.label: A
options.text: Methyldopa

options.label: B
options.text: Captopril

options.label: C
options.text: Labetalol

options.label: D
options.text: Nifedipine

assessmentQuestions.explanation: ACE inhibitors such as Captopril are strictly contraindicated throughout pregnancy because of profound fetotoxicity, renal dysgenesis, oligohydramnios, and neonatal renal failure. Methyldopa, Labetalol, and Nifedipine are standard first-line safe antihypertensives.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: The most powerful research design for establishing causal relationship between exposure and outcome is —

options.label: A
options.text: Analytical studies

options.label: B
options.text: Experimental studies

options.label: C
options.text: Case studies

options.label: D

assessmentQuestions.questionText: There are two inclined surfaces of equal length (L) and same angle of inclination 45° with the horizontal. One of them is rough and the other is perfectly smooth. A given body takes 2 times as much time to slide down on rough surface than on the smooth surface. The coefficient of kinetic friction (μk) between the object and the rough surface is close to
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Using t_rough / t_smooth = n = 2: μk = tan(θ) * (1 - 1/n²) = tan(45°) * (1 - 1/4) = 1 * (3/4) = 0.75.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: The kinetic energies of two similar cars A and B are 100 J and 225 J respectively. On applying breaks, car A stops after 1000 m and car B stops after 1500 m. If FA and FB are the forces applied by the breaks on cars A and B, respectively, then the ratio FA / FB is
assessmentQuestions.explanation: By Work-Energy Theorem, KE = F * s, so F = KE / s. FA = 100 / 1000 = 0.1 N; FB = 225 / 1500 = 0.15 N. Thus FA / FB = 0.1 / 0.15 = 2/3.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: A ball of mass 0.5 kg is dropped from a height of 40 m. The ball hits the ground and rises to a height of 10 m. The impulse imparted to the ball during its collision with the ground is (Take g = 9.8 m/s²)

options.label: A
options.text: 21 NS

options.label: B
options.text: 7 NS

options.label: D
options.text: 84 NS

assessmentQuestions.explanation: Velocity before collision v1 = √(2 * 9.8 * 40) = 28 m/s downwards. Velocity after rebound v2 = √(2 * 9.8 * 10) = 14 m/s upwards. Impulse = m * (v2 - (-v1)) = 0.5 * (14 + 28) = 0.5 * 42 = 21 N·s.

assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: NEET UG 2024 Official Question Paper (Code 45/S6), Question 10

assessmentQuestions.questionText: A 2 amp current is flowing through two different small circular copper coils having radii ratio 1:2. The ratio of their respective magnetic moments will be
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Magnetic dipole moment of a current loop M = I * A = I * π * r². For equal current I, M ∝ r². Thus M1 / M2 = (r1 / r2)² = (1/2)² = 1/4.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: In a certain camera, a combination of four similar thin convex lenses are arranged axially in contact. Then the power of the combination and the total magnification in comparison to the power (p) and magnification (m) for each lens will be, respectively –

assessmentQuestions.questionText: The Sun rotates around its centre once in 27 days. What will be the period of revolution if the Sun were to expand to twice its present radius without any external influence? Assume the Sun to be a sphere of uniform density.

options.label: B
options.text: 105 days

options.label: C
options.text: 115 days

options.text: 108 days

assessmentQuestions.explanation: By conservation of angular momentum: L = I * ω = (2/5 M R²) * (2π / T) = constant. Therefore T2 / T1 = (R2 / R1)² = (2R / R)² = 4. Hence T2 = 4 * 27 = 108 days.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: A body weighs 48 N on the surface of the earth. The gravitational force experienced by the body due to the earth at a height equal to one-third the radius of the earth from its surface is :
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Gravitational acceleration at height h is g' = g / (1 + h/R)². For h = R/3: g' = g / (1 + 1/3)² = g / (4/3)² = 9/16 g. Weight W' = (9/16) * 48 N = 27 N.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: A wire of resistance R is cut into 8 equal pieces. From these pieces two equivalent resistances are made by adding four of these together in parallel. Then these two sets are added in series. The net effective resistance of the combination is :
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Each of the 8 pieces has resistance r = R/8. Connecting 4 pieces in parallel gives an equivalent resistance of (R/8)/4 = R/32. Placing two such groups in series yields R_net = (R/32) + (R/32) = R/16.

assessmentQuestions.questionText: De-Broglie wavelength of an electron orbiting in the n = 2 state of hydrogen atom is close to (Given Bohr radius = 0.052 nm)
assessmentQuestions.explanation: According to Bohr's de Broglie relation, 2πrn = nλ. The radius of n=2 orbit is r2 = r0 * n² = 0.052 nm * 4 = 0.208 nm. Hence λ = (2 * π * r2) / n = (2 * 3.1416 * 0.208 nm) / 2 = 0.653 nm ≈ 0.67 nm.

options.text: Immediately halt the procedure, wipe the head, position the patient supine with feet elevated, check vitals, and summon emergency resuscitation support.

options.label: C
options.text: Administer oral decoction (Kashaya) immediately while keeping the patient seated.

options.label: D
options.text: Instruct the patient to perform Bhastrika Pranayama to normalize hemodynamics.

assessmentQuestions.explanation: Sudden hypotension during Shirodhara may represent vasovagal syncope. The immediate clinical response is procedure cessation, Trendelenburg/supine positioning, airway-breathing-circulation stabilization, and emergency escalation.
assessmentQuestions.subject: Panchakarma
assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: Standard Clinical Guidelines for Panchakarma, Ministry of AYUSH

assessmentQuestions.questionText: A patient presents to a clinical research trial reporting yellow discoloration of sclera and severe nausea two weeks after starting an unlabelled proprietary polyherbal formulation. Under AYUSH Pharmacovigilance (PvPI) guidelines, what is the mandatory regulatory action?
assessmentQuestions.scenarioContext: Adverse Drug Reaction (ADR) reporting and regulatory compliance in institutional clinical practice.

options.label: A
options.text: Discard the unlabelled medication without documentation to avoid legal consequences.

options.label: B
options.text: File a Suspected Adverse Drug Reaction (SADR) reporting form to the nearest AYUSH Intermediary Pharmacovigilance Centre and preserve sample for batch analysis.

options.label: C
options.text: Reassure the patient that jaundice indicates deep metabolic cleansing (Kostha Shodhana).

options.label: D
options.text: Double the formulation dosage to clear the circulating toxins.

assessmentQuestions.explanation: Suspected hepatic ADRs must be reported via standard SADR format to Intermediary/National Pharmacovigilance Centres under the Ministry of AYUSH PvPI framework with batch traceability.
assessmentQuestions.subject: Agadatantra & Pharmacovigilance
assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences (CCRAS) PvPI Protocol

assessmentQuestions.questionText: Under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) integration in an AYUSH hospital, which identification and consent workflow is legally required before retrieving a patient's longitudinal electronic health records across health facilities?
assessmentQuestions.scenarioContext: Digital health implementation, electronic health records (EHR), and patient consent under ABDM in clinical practice.

options.label: A
options.text: Verification via 14-digit ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ID and OTP/biometric consent artifact via ABDM Gateway.

options.label: B
options.text: Verbal consent documented on a plain paper OPD register only.

options.label: C
options.text: Unrestricted electronic sharing of all records among healthcare providers without patient authorization.

options.label: D
options.text: ABDM does not apply to AYUSH practitioners and institutions.

assessmentQuestions.explanation: Under National Health Authority (NHA) & ABDM guidelines for AYUSH, accessing longitudinal health records requires patient ABHA identification and explicit electronic consent artifact generation.
assessmentQuestions.subject: Health Informatics & Governance
assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: National Health Authority (NHA) ABDM AYUSH Implementation Toolkit

assessmentQuestions.questionText: An investigator designs a clinical trial comparing an Ayurvedic classical formulation with standard of care in primary hypertension. To conform to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICMR-AYUSH ethical standards, which step is mandatory before recruiting human subjects?
assessmentQuestions.scenarioContext: Ethical clearances, clinical trial registration, and research methodology for traditional medicine.

options.label: A
options.text: Formal approval from an Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) and prospective registration in CTRI (Clinical Trials Registry - India).

options.label: B
options.text: Publishing preliminary testimonials on social media to build sample enrollment.

options.label: C
options.text: Commencing trial recruitment without ethics review if the drug is mentioned in the Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia.

options.label: D
options.text: Conducting testing exclusively on hospital staff members without written informed consent.

assessmentQuestions.explanation: All clinical trials involving human participants in AYUSH systems require prospective clearance from an accredited IEC and mandatory registration on the CTRI portal before first subject enrollment.
assessmentQuestions.subject: Research Methodology & Medical Ethics
assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: ICMR-AYUSH National Ethical Guidelines for Biomedical Research

assessmentQuestions.questionText: In an Ayurvedic manufacturing unit (Rasashala), a Quality Assurance executive is inspecting a newly prepared batch of Bhasma. Which classical test specifically demonstrates the complete absence of free unreacted metallic particles (subtle grainlessness)?
assessmentQuestions.scenarioContext: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and classical quality control parameters for mineral/herbo-mineral formulations.

options.label: A
options.text: Rekhapurnatva (enters fine skin furrows when rubbed between thumb and index finger)

options.label: B
options.text: Varitara (floats steadily on undisturbed water surface)

options.label: C
options.text: Apurnabhava (does not revert to metallic state upon heating with Mitra Panchaka)

options.label: D
options.text: Niruttha (does not alloy with silver foil at high temperature)

assessmentQuestions.explanation: Rekhapurnatva directly measures extreme fineness and micro-particle size (enters fingerprints/furrows), whereas Apurnabhava/Niruttha test irreversible metallic alteration, and Varitara tests lightness.
assessmentQuestions.subject: Rasashastra & Bhaishajya Kalpana
assessmentQuestions.sourceRef: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part II, Standards for Bhasma
